title: 2021 VIPER Testing at GRC SLOPE Lab
description: Documentation of VIPER Rover Testing at NASA Glenn Research Center's Simulated Lunar Operations Laboratory (SLOPE) Lab in 2021.
keywords: GRC-2022-CM-0102, Videographer of the Year Award 2021 Entry, VIPER,, Moon Rover, SLOPE Lab, Videographer of the Year, Heather Brown, Dr Yajaira Sierra-Sastre, Erin Rezich, Documentation, Facility, Testing
via: the NASA Image and Video Library

transcript.text: This test will help us get ready for the future test during the fall, where we will be doing
further mobility testing for Vipers to understand the rover's performance in terms of how well
the rover can traverse simulated lunar soil, how well it can overcome obstacles like rocks.
And look, is the ideal location for this type of mobility test?
It's a world-class facility.
We have a really well-characterized soil.
We have unique capability that it's indoors and we can control the environment very well.
The tilt bed on the slope itself is very well controlled.
We've recently added software upgrades and advanced our optical tracking system quite
a bit.
We install the 16-camera infrared tracking system, which allow us in the software to identify
individual pieces of the vehicle, which we can track in real time.
It has been challenging to work through this pandemic, but this pandemic has also brought
opportunities to look and understand and learn how we can keep highly performing and
engaging teams.
We encountered procurement delays, COVID delays, snow delays, and we still pulled it off and
made it happen, and it was a huge team effort to get here.
Vipers is the rover of many first.
The first NASA's rover to map water resources.
And it's the first rover to wear a headlight.
For many, many years, I was dreaming about joining NASA and sending big rovers to Mars
and other places in the solar system.
So that dream came through last year when I joined NASA Glenn to lead and manage projects
for future missions to Mars.
And I love Mars, but I also love the moon and the art emissions.
